title: Duals and supertraces for finite complexes realized in condensed coefficients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of positive prime characteristic $p\ne\ell$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension inside $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\underline\Omega=\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ be the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and put $U_s=p_s^*\underline\Omega$, the tensor unit of $\mathcal D_s=D^b_c(s)[[\underline\Omega]]$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, def-sfb-dc-tensor]. Use the scalar inclusion $E\to\Omega$ and its pulled-back coefficient map [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]. On a bounded finite-dimensional $E$-complex, define $\rho_{E,s}$ by replacing each term $E^r$, after choosing a basis, by $U_s^{\oplus r}$, and replacing each differential or chain map matrix by the same matrix acting through $E\to\Omega$. Use total tensor products and Koszul symmetry. This construction is independent of bases up to its canonical change-of-basis isomorphisms, sends quasi-isomorphisms to isomorphisms, and defines an exact strong symmetric monoidal functor
$$\rho_{E,s}:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)\longrightarrow\mathcal D_s,$$
where $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ has the meaning of [def-weil-point-fd-complexes]. It identifies $\rho_{E,s}(E[0])$ with $U_s$ and satisfies $H^i\rho_{E,s}(C)\cong\rho_{E,s}(H^i(C)[0])$. The latter cohomology module evaluated at the geometric point has underlying vector space $H^i(C)\otimes_E\Omega$.

For every $C\in D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$, $\rho_{E,s}(C)$ has a right dual in $\mathcal D_s$, given by $\rho_{E,s}(R\operatorname{Hom}_E(C,E))$. Evaluation, coevaluation and the triangle identities are those of the signed finite-free dual complex, interpreted as internal $U_s$-module maps. For every isomorphism $w:P\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho_{E,s}(C)$ in $\mathcal D_s$ and maps $v:P\to P$, $f:C\to C$ such that $w\circ v=\rho_{E,s}(f)\circ w$, $P$ has a right dual and the categorical trace [sk-d-trace] satisfies
$$\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal D_s}(v)=\epsilon_E\left(\sum_i(-1)^i\operatorname{Tr}_E(H^i(f)\mid H^i(C))\right)\quad\text{in }\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal D_s}(U_s),$$
where $\epsilon_E:E\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal D_s}(U_s)$ sends $a$ to multiplication by its image in $\Omega$, and is an injective ring homomorphism. In particular $U_s$ has a right dual and $\operatorname{tr}(1_{U_s})=\epsilon_E(1)$. Ordinary traces here are those of [def-weil-endomorphism-trace].

proof.text: The point site is essentially small in the coefficient universe by essentiallySmallSelf. Transfer small coproducts through the concrete sectionModuleEquivalence; these coproducts give the total tensor existence property. For every finite frame, its basis gives finite-dimensional terms and zero terms outside its finite rank support. The proved pointSupertraceFrame_mem applies [lem-zl-point-finite-dimensional-complex-cohomology] and supplies the matrix interface default. The named matrix and transported-trace propositions in [def-zl-condensed-point-supertrace-data] expand to exactly the original formulas.

Choose the simultaneously constructed realization, scalars, matrix models and normalized tensor comparisons from [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace-realization]. All parameters are shared in the existential telescope.

Apply [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace-cohomology] to that realization and scalar action, and [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace-duality] to the same realization, scalars and matrix comparison. Assemble their fields with the two tensor normalization equations.

split_report.summary: Constructed the coefficient-point realization explicitly by finite scalar matrices, justified its entire cohomologically defined domain and homotopy descent, constructibility, exactness and strong symmetric monoidal comparisons, transported ordinary signed duality, and computed the internal trace before applying the ordinary-field supertrace. Verified faithful scalar action using profinite-site terminal evaluation. Reused existing tools; no new nodes and no change to the statement.
split_report.blueprint: sk-thm-rationality.proof.md, first sentence (finite determinant factors): the coefficient-point categorical/ordinary trace comparison obligation singled out by the parent split. This is not asserted to be a verbatim blueprint theorem.

tool_uses.why: The generic algebraically closed field/profinite-site equivalence and terminal module evaluation identify the coefficient fiber; no zeta-unit node supplies this site tool.
Its explicit contractible-plus-cohomology decomposition computes the realized cohomology; generic finite-complex algebra.
Exact tensor for finite free internal modules supplies flatness of the actual realized terms.
Exact symmetric monoidal equivalence transports the existing sheaf K-flat criterion to internal modules, preventing a coefficient-category conflation.
K-flatness of bounded flat sheaf complexes justifies the actual derived tensor computation.
Ordinary finite-free signed duality equations over E and the chain-level ordinary trace, subsequently interpreted by our constructed monoidal functor.
Only its ordinary-field supertrace clause (4) is used, after computing the internal trace by matrices.
